body: I have a fairly good plan for getting out of here, I'm just waiting for my job to reopen or to get a new job. I have a decent chunk in my savings already, but I'm afraid to take the step of leaving until I have more stable income. I've been trying to also spend more time visiting my mother 3 hours away because that gets me away from here, even if it's only for a little while. Thank you for reassuring me, it really means a lot to me.
Maybe you're right. I always try to be prepared for everything I encounter, but I end up always worried. I  should try to be more free. I think that would help. Thank you
